definitions: Be favourably disposed towards or willing to do something.
Have a tendency or propensity to do something or to be in a particular state.
Lean or turn away from a given plane or direction, especially the vertical or horizontal.
Cause to lean, bend, or tip.
Bend (one's head or body) forward and downwards.
examples: I incline to agree with you.
The patient's condition inclines to improve.
The land inclines gently towards the sea.
He inclined his head in thought.
She inclined her body to get a better view.
